# Lumen snapshot

This is a mixed, bounded snapshot of LumenTokens and LumenUI. The base remains
revision d10900ada6ecc7001460bf2aff40ae1bddef626d. The single implementation file
Sources/LumenUI/LumenSettings.swift is copied exactly from committed revision
46b7dc04458991093301dc9c05ca35c82f69a7ea, adding the complete settings window
scaffold and its scene helper. No other vendor implementation is updated by this
source synchronization. This does not claim that the whole package is at the
newer revision.

The manifest remains reduced to the two products used by AIRS. The Catalog,
examples, upstream tests, research captures, Git history and development records
are excluded. Existing accepted evidence is reused for unchanged vendor files;
the changed Settings implementation receives a separate one-file content
inspection, with the pinned source identity recorded in the export metadata.

Lumen and AIRS share the same owner. On 2026-10-19 the owner confirmed
authorship of both and authorized including Lumen with AIRS for distribution.
On 2026-10-22 the owner licensed this bundled snapshot under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
Third-party platform material retains its applicable terms; see
